jobPostingInfo.title: Software Development Engineer II - Web
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
WORKDAY_JIOSTAR_FULL_DESCRIPTION_TOKEN

JioStar is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build high-scale web experiences for millions of viewers.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build responsive web applications used by millions of daily active users.
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to ship customer-facing features.
  • Own performance, reliability, and code quality for the services you build.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building production web applications.
  • Strong fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience with React or an equivalent component-based framework.

JioStar is an equal opportunity employer.
